sources.quote: WASP-7 b is an extrasolar planet discovered in 2008.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around WASP-7. Its orbit and size follow Southworth et al. 2011's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-7 b"
sources.quote: This 5-day period planet, orbiting a round the star WASP-7, is slightly smaller than Jupiter, roughly the same mass and more dense.
